name: 80831 · Peyton, CO
findings: ZIP 80831 (Peyton) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80831 (Peyton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80831 (Peyton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
